hardware: M4 Max (40 GPU cores, 48 GiB UMA), macOS 26.6.2, Apple GPU family 9
repeat_protocol: Separate processes per variant, runs sequential. 15 tokens / 8 output warmup followed by 4000 / 64 greedy uncached requests (seed 42). Two native GPU-sampled requests per kernel, three counter-free requests per Atomic Engine path, two stock Splash requests. Mean across all relevant samples, including the first. Kernel and verify clocks and client TPS are from independent runs. Dump requests excluded from all timing.

boundaries.kernel: Native Metal counter interval of the split attention compute pass; ten invocations per verify step. Main and reduction are timed separately. Excludes projections, cache store, synchronization and host work.
boundaries.verify: All target work for one draft block, including waits and all four streamed MoE callbacks in Atomic Engine. Atomic Engine wall brackets llama_process through existing llama_synchronize using a lightweight host clock. Splash needs a diagnostic command boundary around target forward (submit through wait). No draft or accept in either.
boundaries.client: (64-1)/(last token event - first token event), excluding prefill. Stock and group8 from static server built with the archived opt-in patch off/on, without diagnostic hooks. Alternate precision variant from the trial binary with GPU counters off.
boundaries.budget: Atomic Engine peak is the managed ledger high-water, Splash peak is memory_actual.peak_bytes.

implementation.mode: Experimental patch for a separate static Metal llama-server build. The ordinary working server is unchanged. Apply in a copy of the corresponding checkout, build llama-server, and set ATOMIC_QWEN35_VERIFY_GQA8=1 on the 24 GiB profile. Flag unset/0 selects stock.
implementation.mechanism: One verify row and eight query heads per KV head per workgroup. 32 splits of 128 positions. SIMD-group 8x8 matrix multiplies, FP32 accumulation, FP16 probabilities and an unchanged GGML split reduction. Uses existing GGML KV and split scratch layout.
implementation.splash_mechanism: The page tile combines multiple verification rows with eight query heads per KV head, using Metal matmul2d for QK and PV, BF16 queries/probabilities and FP32 accumulator. Different width, layout and continuation.

logits.layout: Each row below is [batch_length, row_index, input_token, absolute_position]. Includes anchor and every proposal, also rejected proposals. Every listed row was compared across the entire vocabulary. Group8 diagnostic and packaged-patch dumps have identical hashes.
